def execute_command(image) -> ImagePatch:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    plate_patches = image_patch.find("plate")
    donut_patches = image_patch.find("donut")
    
    if not plate_patches or not donut_patches:
        return image_patch
    
    plate_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2, (p.lower + p.upper) / 2 for p in plate_patches]
    donut_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2, (p.lower + p.upper) / 2 for p in donut_patches]
    
    closest_plate = min(plate_patches, key=lambda p: min(distance(p, ImagePatch(None, *d)) for d in donut_centers))
    
    return closest_plate
